## Definition of Done

Leave these unchecked while work is still draft. Every ready PR must have every
item checked.

- [ ] This is the only open PR and it targets `main` directly.
- [ ] Applicable acceptance validation for the exact head SHA is satisfied by hosted CI or a documented permitted fallback.
- [ ] Authoritative counts, identities, evidence, contracts, and docs touched by this PR are reconciled.
- [ ] No checkpoint document being merged remains `ACTIVE`.
- [ ] `STATE.md` describes the correct post-merge next action/blocker.
- [ ] No downstream substantive work was started before this work reached Done.
